query:
hive-cli is giving me this error, not sure what it means:

$ hive schema:publish schema.graphql --service billing
Error HIVE301: The SDL is not valid at line 12, column 3: Unexpected token '{'.
expected_behavior: Does not run any commands while analyzing the command and error code (steps 1-2 of the skill)
Identifies the error as HIVE301 (invalid SDL / GraphQL syntax error)
Fetches or references the CLI error docs (https://the-guild.dev/graphql/hive/docs/api-reference/cli#errors) to ground the explanation
Explains the cause as a GraphQL syntax error in the schema file, pointing at the reported line/column
Suggests the fix: correct the syntax error in schema.graphql near line 12 and retry
Does not confuse this with a composition or token error
